changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Currency conversion gets one definition (issue #243). Every row of holdings_overview is restated in the rates-anchor currency, the one whose own currency_rates row stores rate 1: rate is the wallet currency's stored rate, or 1 when it has no row, and the two anchor columns are the corresponding amounts multiplied by it. The view stops at the anchor on purpose, because the display currency is a runtime parameter and cannot live in a view. currency_rates is keyed by currency_code, so the LEFT JOIN never multiplies a holding.
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW finances.holdings_valued AS SELECT holdings_overview.*, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate, holdings_overview.cost_basis * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS cost_basis_anchor, holdings_overview.current_value * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS current_value_anchor FROM finances.holdings_overview LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = holdings_overview.wallet_currency;
